title: listworkspaces_success
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/workspaces returns 200 with a list of authorized workspaces when accessed with valid context.

title: createworkspace_success
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/workspaces with valid workspace data returns 200 with the created Workspace object.

title: listworkspaces_unauthorized
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/workspaces with invalid or unauthorized access context returns an error response such as 401 or 403 and no workspace data.

title: createworkspace_validationerror
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/workspaces with malformed payload returns a 4xx validation error and does not create a workspace.

title: createrun_success
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/runs with valid workspace_id, revision, task, acceptance criteria, autonomy, routing mode, and budgets returns 200 with a Run record.

title: startrun_success
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/runs/{id}/start for an existing queued/planning run returns 200 with the run state updated to execution.

title: createrun_validationerror
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/runs with missing required fields or invalid budget values returns a 4xx validation error and does not create a run.

title: startrun_invalidrunerror
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/runs/{id}/start for a nonexistent, unauthorized, or already terminal run returns a 4xx or 403 error and the run state remains unchanged.
